diagnoses.description:
Attempted to use an unavailable dependency (pandas) in the environment; needed to fall back to standard-library CSV parsing.
Evidence: Python preview failed with “ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pandas'”.
Trajectory location: turn 1

Misuse of the terminal tool interface by providing multiple separate commands in one tool call, requiring reformatting into a single chained command or separate calls.
Evidence: Tool returned: “Cannot execute multiple commands at once. Please run each command separately OR chain them into a single command via && or ;”.
Trajectory location: turn 3

A syntax/quoting error in the long bash -lc heredoc pipeline (notably an extra “)” in the embedded python snippet in Turn 4) caused the command stream to break, after which subsequent content was misinterpreted and the session effectively dropped into Node REPL, blocking intended shell commands until manually exited.
Evidence: Turn 4 shows “bash: syntax error near unexpected token `('” and then “Welcome to Node.js v18.19.1.”; Turn 5 shows Node REPL prompts and many “Invalid REPL keyword” errors until Turn 6 exits.
Trajectory location: turns 4-6

The implementation focused on the explicitly specified bubble chart and table and omitted any visualization of individual stock price histories, despite the task instruction referencing /root/data/indiv-stock/ for “individual stock price histories”.
Evidence: visualization.js is generated from stock-descriptions.csv metadata and does not load or visualize any data from /root/output/data/indiv-stock/ price history CSVs; the app implements only the bubble chart + table described in the chart requirements.
Trajectory location: turn 11 (requirements coverage)
